              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.

    put:

          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1

        description: The details of the new vet visit.

            schema:

      responses:

        500:
          description: Server error.

            application/json:

                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /pettypes:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressPresenceValidation"
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner, flat single-line form. Accepted
            for backward compatibility. On create the structured 'addressLine1'
            (and optional 'addressLine2') are preferred when supplied; otherwise
            this flat value is used. An owner must supply an address in EITHER
            form. The stored and returned 'address' is the normalized address:
            when the structured form is used it is the normalized 'addressLine1'
            with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when
            'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized on
            create (trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common
            street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized on create like 'addressLine1' and, when present,
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            the result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The stored and
            returned value is that E.164 string, e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes
            '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.EmailDomainValidation"
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            present. When supplied it must be valid for the region derived from the
            owner's city via the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW,
            Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD): NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned as supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. When supplied it must not be later than the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2024-01-15'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.RegistrationDateValidation"
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand',
            computed as the owner's age in whole years on the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag used on create. When an existing owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name, compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace, and the same
            postcode), the create is rejected with 409 unless this flag is set
            to true, which acknowledges the two owners share a household and
            allows the create to proceed as a declared household member. It does
            not create the household link (the household id is derived
            deterministically); it only bypasses the duplicate block.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A link to this owner's own resource, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as the 'title' followed by a
                single space and the last name (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the
                last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans as the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes, e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'. The raw 'telephone' remains in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity contract carried by this
                response. Always 2 for the version-2 identity: the memberId,
                identityKey and householdId are grouped under the nested
                'identity' object and are derived with the version-2 algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year the business-day-adjusted
                registration date falls in. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named by the calendar year in which it ends, so a registration
                date of 2026-07-01 is 'FY27' while 2026-06-30 is 'FY26'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Start at 0; add 2 when an email
                address is present; add 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 for a household of 3 or more members;
                add 3 when the owner's tenure (the number of fiscal years elapsed
                since the registration date's fiscal year) exceeds 1.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                'membershipPoints': 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC,
                Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent
                when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, before this owner was
                created, sharing the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create and never changed
                afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the moment this owner was created,
                signalling a bulk-signup surge; otherwise false. Assigned on
                create and never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, its city already
                held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard capacity limit
                of 50); otherwise false. Assigned on create and never changed
                afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at create time, the owner was not a hard (identity-key)
                duplicate but an existing owner's last name shared its Soundex code
                and the same postcode while its identity key differed, flagging it
                as a possible duplicate; otherwise false. Assigned on create and
                never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of, set only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; otherwise
                absent. Assigned on create and never changed afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel for the owner, derived from the
                stored contact details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as the owner's age
                in whole years on the registration date: 'MINOR' (under 18),
                'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65 and over). Absent when no birth
                date was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>':
                'PREMIUM' when 'membershipLevel' is 3 or more else 'STANDARD',
                joined with 'METRO' when the owner's locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD) else 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants review because any of the following
                hold: the owner is a possible duplicate ('possibleDuplicate' is
                true), the owner's email domain is disposable-adjacent (not itself
                on the disposable blocklist, but sharing a blocklisted provider's
                second-level label, e.g. the same provider under a different TLD or
                a subdomain of it), or the owner's city is over its soft capacity
                ('capacityWarning' is true); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The derived key used for duplicate detection: the lower-case hex
                SHA-256 of the normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or an
                empty string when absent) and the Soundex code of the last name,
                joined with '|'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
                identity keys are equal, so e.g. two owners sharing a surname and
                postcode but with different telephones remain distinct.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining the
                record, and deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
            - deleted
    OwnerPage:

        totalElements:
          title: Total elements

    PetFields:

      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identity: the group of derived identifiers that
        reference the owner. Each is rederived with the version-2 algorithm,
        which mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag, so every identifier differs from
        the value the version-1 algorithm produced. The user-facing 'locality',
        'timezone' and owner-segment region remain the plain region code and
        never carry the 'V2' tag.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member identifier, formatted
            '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where REGION is the version-2 identity
            region code (the postcode-derived region code with the fixed 'V2'
            version tag mixed in, e.g. 'NSWV2'), FY the 2-digit fiscal year,
            HASH8 the 8-character upper-hex hash and CHK a single Luhn check
            digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. If the
            identifier collides with an existing owner's, '-<n>' is appended with
            the smallest n of 2 or more that makes it unique.
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV2263F5A9C2E4'
          readOnly: true

          title: Household ID

            household. It is derived deterministically with the version-2
            algorithm as the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the fixed
            'V2' version tag, the owner's normalized last name and postcode, so
            every owner with the same last name and postcode carries the same
            value automatically.

          example: '3f5a9c2e1b7d'

          readOnly: true
      required:
        - memberId
        - householdId
        - identityKey

      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressPresenceValidation"
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner, flat single-line form. Accepted
            for backward compatibility. On create the structured 'addressLine1'
            (and optional 'addressLine2') are preferred when supplied; otherwise
            this flat value is used. An owner must supply an address in EITHER
            form. The stored and returned 'address' is the normalized address:
            when the structured form is used it is the normalized 'addressLine1'
            with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when
            'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized on
            create (trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common
            street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized on create like 'addressLine1' and, when present,
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            the result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The stored and
            returned value is that E.164 string, e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes
            '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.EmailDomainValidation"
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            present. When supplied it must be valid for the region derived from the
            owner's city via the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW,
            Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD): NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned as supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. When supplied it must not be later than the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2024-01-15'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.RegistrationDateValidation"
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand',
            computed as the owner's age in whole years on the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag used on create. When an existing owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name, compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace, and the same
            postcode), the create is rejected with 409 unless this flag is set
            to true, which acknowledges the two owners share a household and
            allows the create to proceed as a declared household member. It does
            not create the household link (the household id is derived
            deterministically); it only bypasses the duplicate block.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A link to this owner's own resource, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as the 'title' followed by a
                single space and the last name (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the
                last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans as the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes, e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'. The raw 'telephone' remains in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity contract carried by this
                response. Always 2 for the version-2 identity: the memberId,
                identityKey and householdId are grouped under the nested
                'identity' object and are derived with the version-2 algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year the business-day-adjusted
                registration date falls in. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named by the calendar year in which it ends, so a registration
                date of 2026-07-01 is 'FY27' while 2026-06-30 is 'FY26'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Start at 0; add 2 when an email
                address is present; add 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 for a household of 3 or more members;
                add 3 when the owner's tenure (the number of fiscal years elapsed
                since the registration date's fiscal year) exceeds 1.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                'membershipPoints': 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC,
                Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent
                when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, before this owner was
                created, sharing the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create and never changed
                afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the moment this owner was created,
                signalling a bulk-signup surge; otherwise false. Assigned on
                create and never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, its city already
                held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard capacity limit
                of 50); otherwise false. Assigned on create and never changed
                afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at create time, the owner was not a hard (identity-key)
                duplicate but an existing owner's last name shared its Soundex code
                and the same postcode while its identity key differed, flagging it
                as a possible duplicate; otherwise false. Assigned on create and
                never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of, set only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; otherwise
                absent. Assigned on create and never changed afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel for the owner, derived from the
                stored contact details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as the owner's age
                in whole years on the registration date: 'MINOR' (under 18),
                'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65 and over). Absent when no birth
                date was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>':
                'PREMIUM' when 'membershipLevel' is 3 or more else 'STANDARD',
                joined with 'METRO' when the owner's locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD) else 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants review because any of the following
                hold: the owner is a possible duplicate ('possibleDuplicate' is
                true), the owner's email domain is disposable-adjacent (not itself
                on the disposable blocklist, but sharing a blocklisted provider's
                second-level label, e.g. the same provider under a different TLD or
                a subdomain of it), or the owner's city is over its soft capacity
                ('capacityWarning' is true); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining the
                record, and deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
            - deleted

lines: +        The owner's version-2 identity: the group of derived identifiers that
+        reference the owner. Each is rederived with the version-2 algorithm,
+        which mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag, so every identifier differs from
+        the value the version-1 algorithm produced. The user-facing 'locality',
+        'timezone' and owner-segment region remain the plain region code and
+            The owner's unified member identifier, formatted
+            '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where REGION is the version-2 identity

+            the smallest n of 2 or more that makes it unique.

+            household. It is derived deterministically with the version-2
+            algorithm as the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the fixed
+            'V2' version tag, the owner's normalized last name and postcode, so

+            The derived key used for duplicate detection: the lower-case hex

+            version tag, the normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or an
+            empty string when absent) and the Soundex code of the last name,
+            joined with '|'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
+            identity keys are equal, so e.g. two owners sharing a surname and

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressPresenceValidation"
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner, flat single-line form. Accepted
            for backward compatibility. On create the structured 'addressLine1'
            (and optional 'addressLine2') are preferred when supplied; otherwise
            this flat value is used. An owner must supply an address in EITHER
            form. The stored and returned 'address' is the normalized address:
            when the structured form is used it is the normalized 'addressLine1'
            with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when
            'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address.
            Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized on
            create (trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common
            street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized on create like 'addressLine1' and, when present,
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            the result must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The stored and
            returned value is that E.164 string, e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes
            '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.EmailDomainValidation"
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; validated only when
            present. When supplied it must be valid for the region derived from the
            owner's city via the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW,
            Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD): NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned as supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. When supplied it must not be later than the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2024-01-15'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.RegistrationDateValidation"
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand',
            computed as the owner's age in whole years on the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag used on create. When an existing owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name, compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace, and the same
            postcode), the create is rejected with 409 unless this flag is set
            to true, which acknowledges the two owners share a household and
            allows the create to proceed as a declared household member. It does
            not create the household link (the household id is derived
            deterministically); it only bypasses the duplicate block.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identity: the group of derived identifiers that
        reference the owner. Each is rederived with the version-2 algorithm,
        which mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag, so every identifier differs from
        the value the version-1 algorithm produced. The user-facing 'locality',
        'timezone' and owner-segment region remain the plain region code and
        never carry the 'V2' tag.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member identifier, formatted
            '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where REGION is the version-2 identity
            region code (the postcode-derived region code with the fixed 'V2'
            version tag mixed in, e.g. 'NSWV2'), FY the 2-digit fiscal year,
            HASH8 the 8-character upper-hex hash and CHK a single Luhn check
            digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. If the
            identifier collides with an existing owner's, '-<n>' is appended with
            the smallest n of 2 or more that makes it unique.
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV2263F5A9C2E4'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable identifier shared by owners who belong to the same
            household. It is derived deterministically with the version-2
            algorithm as the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the fixed
            'V2' version tag, the owner's normalized last name and postcode, so
            every owner with the same last name and postcode carries the same
            value automatically.
          type: string
          example: '3f5a9c2e1b7d'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The derived key used for duplicate detection: the lower-case hex
            SHA-256, derived with the version-2 algorithm, of the fixed 'V2'
            version tag, the normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or an
            empty string when absent) and the Soundex code of the last name,
            joined with '|'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
            identity keys are equal, so e.g. two owners sharing a surname and
            postcode but with different telephones remain distinct.
          type: string
          example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - memberId
        - householdId
        - identityKey
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A link to this owner's own resource, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formed as the 'title' followed by a
                single space and the last name (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the
                last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans as the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes, e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'. The raw 'telephone' remains in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity contract carried by this
                response. Always 2 for the version-2 identity: the memberId,
                identityKey and householdId are grouped under the nested
                'identity' object and are derived with the version-2 algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year the business-day-adjusted
                registration date falls in. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named by the calendar year in which it ends, so a registration
                date of 2026-07-01 is 'FY27' while 2026-06-30 is 'FY26'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Start at 0; add 2 when an email
                address is present; add 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 for a household of 3 or more members;
                add 3 when the owner's tenure (the number of fiscal years elapsed
                since the registration date's fiscal year) exceeds 1.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                'membershipPoints': 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The region derived from the owner's city using a fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC,
                Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region
                using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent
                when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, before this owner was
                created, sharing the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create and never changed
                afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the moment this owner was created,
                signalling a bulk-signup surge; otherwise false. Assigned on
                create and never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the moment this owner was created, its city already
                held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard capacity limit
                of 50); otherwise false. Assigned on create and never changed
                afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at create time, the owner was not a hard (identity-key)
                duplicate but an existing owner's last name shared its Soundex code
                and the same postcode while its identity key differed, flagging it
                as a possible duplicate; otherwise false. Assigned on create and
                never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of, set only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true; otherwise
                absent. Assigned on create and never changed afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel for the owner, derived from the
                stored contact details: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as the owner's age
                in whole years on the registration date: 'MINOR' (under 18),
                'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65 and over). Absent when no birth
                date was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>':
                'PREMIUM' when 'membershipLevel' is 3 or more else 'STANDARD',
                joined with 'METRO' when the owner's locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD) else 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants review because any of the following
                hold: the owner is a possible duplicate ('possibleDuplicate' is
                true), the owner's email domain is disposable-adjacent (not itself
                on the disposable blocklist, but sharing a blocklisted provider's
                second-level label, e.g. the same provider under a different TLD or
                a subdomain of it), or the owner's city is over its soft capacity
                ('capacityWarning' is true); otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining the
                record, and deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
            - deleted

All changes are complete and the full test suite is green. No dangling references remain.

## Summary

I released **version 2 of the owner identity**. Since the DTOs are generated from `openapi.yml` at build time, I changed both the spec and the derivation logic.

### Identifier derivation (all rederived to mix in a fixed `V2` tag)
- **`Regions.java`** — added `forPostcodeV2(postcode)`, the plain region code with the `V2` tag appended (e.g. `NSW` → `NSWV2`). Used **only inside identifiers**.
- **`ClinicServiceImpl.generateMemberId`** — the `memberId` region segment now uses `forPostcodeV2`, so `NSW2716E6609E1` becomes `NSWV22716E6609E7`. The letter prefix differs from every v1 region, so no v1 `memberId` can recur.
- **`Owner.getHouseholdId` / `getIdentityKey`** — the hashed input is now prefixed with the `V2|` tag (constant `IDENTITY_VERSION_TAG`), so both hashes change and no v1 value is reproduced. Duplicate detection still works because both sides compute v2 keys consistently.

### Keeping the `V2` tag out of user-facing fields
- **`OwnerMapper.formatLocality`** now derives the region directly from the postcode (plain `NSW`), decoupled from the now-tagged `memberId`.
- **`formatFiscalYear`** now derives directly from the registration date (same value as before, no longer parsed out of the `memberId`, whose region now contains the tag). The unused `memberIdRegion` helper was removed.
- `timezone` and `ownerSegment`'s derived region follow `formatLocality`, so they stay plain.

### Response shape
